capabilities: insert an empty WakaTime code block into the LifeOS daily note template
fill and update the stats box on note creation, hourly, or on demand
display the day's top projects, languages, editors and categories
sync stats for today or yesterday via commands and hotkeys
copy the stats of any date to the clipboard for weekly notes or reports
extras: Before community-plugin publication it can be installed via BRAT from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: Fork of simonla/obsidian_waka_box (MIT); the daily note layout follows LifeOS.
problem: Obsidian daily notes have no built-in way to display coding time tracked by the WakaTime service.

relations.evidence: LifeOS enabled, with Periodic Notes turned on
A WakaTime account; paste your personal OAuth token into the plugin settings

summary: WakaTime stats box that writes your daily coding project, language, editor and category stats into your LifeOS daily note.
